spec_match.rationale: Policy values taken from SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel.yaml (0/1/2, Chrome 83+, dynamic refresh, per profile); review channels are Google's documented Safe Browsing ones.

interactive.rationale: URL form builds four live links; six-item self-review with live progress; policy generator for Linux/Windows/macOS with mandatory/recommended and copy.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Status lookup, Search Console review, error report and policy generator all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Invalid/non-http URL rejected with aria-invalid; recommended vs mandatory paths; level 0/1 explain the absence of scam checks.

references.rationale: chromestatus, enterprise policy list, Search Central social-engineering doc, Transparency Report, report_error, Chrome Help.

conformance.rationale: no-web-exposed-safe-browsing-state assertion backs the 'no status API' note.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless google-chrome via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment), desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch: every control clicked, live readouts changed as expected, zero console errors / page errors / failed requests, no horizontal overflow; screenshots Read. Links built with encoded host; policy text verified for all three platforms; copy reported 'Copied'.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts link construction and policy generation validity.

accessibility.rationale: Fieldset/legend checklist, labelled selects, status regions; native checkboxes are 22px inside 44px label hit areas.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Selects stack to one column at 360px; no overflow.

openQuestions.title: Verify Search Console resource_id deep link
openQuestions.detail: The resource_id query parameter deep link was not verified while signed in; confirm it opens the right property.

Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp

openQuestions.title: No real Enhanced Safe Browsing run
openQuestions.detail: The server-side check itself cannot be triggered or observed from a page; nobody has confirmed end-to-end on an ESB-enabled Chrome 155 desktop profile that the documented triggers start an intelligent scan.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible form validation url input with live result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use :user-invalid for styling only after interaction and sync aria-invalid with an aria-describedby error message.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: input:user-invalid border, aria-invalid set on failed submit and cleared on success, error text in aria-live element referenced by aria-describedby.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Playwright: bad input produced error text and aria-invalid=true.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive two column tool layout mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets usable and content within its container on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Grids use auto-fit minmax(min(100%, Nrem), 1fr); buttons min 44x44; wide content wraps or scrolls in labelled regions.

guidanceConsulted.query: copy to clipboard button accessible feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Copy via navigator.clipboard.writeText with try/catch, report success AND failure in a role=status bubble outside the button, clear after timeout, don't disable the button.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: status span outside the button, data-copied/data-failed outline (not colour only — text message), timer reset on repeat clicks. Invoker commands not used — exception: plain click handler keeps one code path for the demo's explicit writeText call.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Playwright: 'Copied 91 chars' and clipboard.readText() returned the payload.
